notes.title: Update : ver1.01
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]
- In the in-game question, when entering the last updated date of the official Twitter account of the movie and the Twitter account of the lead actress, the correct answer was set to the time zone based on JST (Japan Standard Time).
For the English version, the time zone was changed to PST (Pacific Standard Time).
The Japanese version has not been changed.

Thank you, aralellia-san, for reporting this in your review.
Your answer was the correct answer!
